decisions.reason: As a newly launched, specialized particle-therapy scanning product with rollout extending into 2019, it is more likely to be supported further than withdrawn despite its delayed US availability.
A small volume ionization chamber fits a core dosimetry niche for a measurement-focused German manufacturer, so an immediate withdrawal after launch would be unlikely.
This product appears to be another small volume ionization chamber variant, and firms in this segment typically retain such newly introduced portfolio options unless demand is clearly poor.
A standard clinical ionization chamber is a mainstream, repeat-demand product category and would normally be kept as part of the firm's core offering.
An ionization chamber for relative dosimetry is complementary to the firm's existing measurement products, making near-term discontinuation unlikely.
A thimble ionization chamber is a well-established clinical dosimetry format, so management would usually keep it on the market to build installed-base sales.
